company.name: ENAI
company.positioning: Governed revenue execution for complex vertical markets
company.description: ENAI turns account signals and company context into governed revenue work. It researches accounts, maps buying committees, prepares approved outreach, qualifies replies, and hands sellers meetings with source context and an audit trail.
company.notAnAcademicOrganization: ENAI is a commercial revenue technology company and is not the European Network for Academic Integrity.

product.problem: Revenue teams have data across CRMs, enrichment tools, inboxes, calendars, and market sources, but people still perform the research, interpretation, coordination, and follow-up manually.
workflow: Map the buying committee and route into the account
Qualify replies and escalate judgment calls
Hand the seller a meeting with account and source context
differentiators: Vertical market context rather than one generic outbound playbook
Customer-defined approval, exclusion, pacing, and messaging rules
Human escalation for sensitive accounts and unsupported claims
Execution across the path from signal to seller handoff
product.notAnAiSdr: ENAI can complete work that often sits with SDR, research, marketing, and revenue operations teams, but it is not positioned as a generic AI BDR or AI SDR. Its category is governed revenue execution.

verticalFocus.focus: Expansion, lane, capacity, network, commercial, operations, finance, and procurement context
Provider priorities, service-line change, stakeholder mapping, controlled terminology, and review workflows
Distributor, channel, assortment, regional demand, buyer, commercial, and finance context

principles: Customer data and workspace boundaries are respected
Judgment calls retain a human owner
Customer data is not used to train generalized AI models

commercial.pricing: ENAI does not publish standard pricing. Deployment scope depends on the workflow, account coverage, integrations, governance requirements, and level of managed execution.

evidence.recognition: ENAI was selected to present as part of the Agentic AI showcase at Web Summit Qatar 2026.

faq.question: What is ENAI?
faq.answer: ENAI is the Revenue Operating System for governed revenue execution in complex vertical markets.

faq.question: Is ENAI an AI SDR or AI BDR?
faq.answer: No. ENAI coordinates account research, buying-committee mapping, controlled outreach, reply qualification, and seller handoff under company-defined rules.

faq.question: Which markets does ENAI focus on?
faq.answer: ENAI currently demonstrates vertical execution for logistics and transport, healthcare, and wholesale and B2B retail.

faq.question: How does ENAI control autonomous action?
faq.answer: Customers define approval rules, exclusions, pacing, claims, and escalation paths. ENAI keeps work connected to source context and hands judgment calls to people.

faq.question: How much does ENAI cost?
faq.answer: Commercial scope depends on the workflow, account coverage, integrations, governance requirements, and managed-execution needs. ENAI provides pricing after reviewing the target market and deployment.
